blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Curriculum learning orders samples by difficulty, but difficulty alone does not establish supervision reliability for dense prediction. Easy samples can expose shortcuts, hard samples can be informative, and noisy or ambiguous samples can mislead training. Building on our conference method CurriSeg, we present PaceShift, a stabilize-then-challenge paradigm combining supervision-adaptive curriculum selection with guarded spectral post-training. A learning-dynamics view motivates separating supervision reliability from temporal update value and applying spectral challenges after stabilization. The first phase estimates reliability from available supervision, augmentation consistency, model disagreement, and prediction certainty. Temporal statistics guide sample weighting, while pixel-uncertainty weights reduce the early influence of uncertain regions. The second phase ranks predictions from multiple spectral views using supervision agreement, robustness, reference consistency, and penalties. A pairwise preference objective measured against the frozen Phase-I reference, together with an anchor, refines the prediction. The framework supports full, weak, semi-supervised, and model-derived supervision. Experiments across context-entangled content segmentation (CECS), broader dense-prediction tasks, and foundation-model and cross-modal adaptations show accuracy gains. Targeted diagnostics indicate improved pooled calibration and corruption robustness in the evaluated settings. PaceShift preserves the deployed architecture and adds no inference computation. Code will be publicly released.
blocks.zh: 课程学习通过难度来定下样本,但单靠难度并不能确立对密集预测的监督可靠性. 简单样品可以暴露出捷径,硬样品可以提供信息,吵闹或模棱两可的样品可以误导训练. 根据我们的会议方法CurriSeg,我们介绍PaceShift,一种稳定、当时充满挑战的范式,将监督-适应性课程选择与防守光谱后培训相结合。 学习动力学观点促使将监督可靠性与时间更新值区分开来,并在稳定后应用光谱挑战. 第一阶段从现有监督、增强一致性、模型分歧和预测确定性中估算可靠性。 时间统计指导了样本权重,而像素-不确定性权重则会减少不确定区域的早期影响. 第二阶段利用监督协议、稳健性、参考一致性和惩罚,从多光谱角度对预测进行排序。 对照被冻结的第一阶段参考物衡量的双向偏好目标,加上一个锚,可以完善预测. 该框架支持全面、薄弱、半监督以及模型产生的监督。 跨上下文缠绕内容分解(CECS)的实验,更广泛的密集预测任务,以及基础模型和跨模式的改造,都显示出精度的提高. 有针对性的诊断表明,在被评价环境中,集合校准工作有所改善,腐败程度强劲。 PaceShift 保存了已部署的架构并添加了不推断计算. 代码将公开发布。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Dense prediction assigns a structured label to every pixel and underpins perception across medical, autonomous, and industrial applications [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Most progress has been architectural: stronger backbones [ 6 ] , dedicated detectors with multi-scale aggregation [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] , attention [ 10 ] , and frequency-aware modules [ 11 ] .
We instead argue that dense prediction is limited not only by network capacity but also by training-signal reliability and the order in which it is consumed (Fig. ).
blocks.zh:
理智预测为每个像素指定了一个结构化的标签,并支撑着医学、自主和工业应用的认知[1、2、3、4、5]。 大部分进展是建筑:更强大的骨干[6],具有多尺度聚合的专用探测器[7,8,9],注意[10],以及频率感知模块[11].
我们反而认为,密集预测不仅受到网络能力的限制,而且受到训练信号可靠性和消费顺序的限制(图)。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Curriculum paradigms for dense prediction. A naive curriculum orders samples easy-to-hard by a static ground-truth difficulty and can strengthen reliance on fragile texture cues. CurriSeg adds temporal statistics and a stabilize-then-challenge schedule, but its score is defined by dense-mask error and its single-radius challenge is unguarded. PaceShift keeps the same overall two-phase training skeleton and changes two core components: a four-cue supervision-adaptive score ρ i \rho_{i} and a guarded multi-radius spectral challenge during post-training, without changing the deployed model architecture.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2: 密集预测的课程范式。 幼稚的课程通过静态的地面真实困难而容易地采集样本,可以加强对脆弱纹理提示的依赖。 CurriSeg增加了时间统计和稳定-时挑战表,但其得分由密集-掩码误差定义,其单射线挑战无防护. PaceShift保持了相同的整体两阶段训练骨架,并改变两个核心部分:一个四级监听-适应分数 ^ i \rho_{i}和一个在训练后被注意的多辐射光谱挑战,而不改变部署的模型架构.

blocks.en:
The reliability problem is sharpest in context-entangled content segmentation (CECS), where objects share intrinsic visual patterns with their background, as in camouflaged object detection [ 7 ] , transparent object detection [ 12 ] , and concealed defect detection [ 4 , 13 ] .
We also include polyp segmentation as a CECS-related task with low boundary contrast, local ambiguity, and annotation uncertainty.
Existing methods address the resulting feature ambiguity mainly by enhancing representations [ 11 , 14 ] . Yet a more basic bottleneck is the learning dynamics that arise when the data distribution is entangled. We make this concrete with three observations that, while most visible in CECS, recur across dense prediction.
blocks.zh:
可靠性问题在上下文缠绕的内容分割(CECS)中最为尖锐,其中物体与其背景有着内在的视觉模式,如伪装物体检测[7],透明物体检测[12],隐藏缺陷检测[4,13].
我们还将多段分解作为与CECS有关的任务,其边界对比度低,局部模糊,注释不确定。
现有方法主要通过加强表述[11、14]解决由此产生的特征模糊问题。 然而,一个更基本的瓶颈是数据分布缠绕时出现的学习动态。 我们用三种观察来制作这个具体体,这些观察体虽然在CECS中最为明显,但却在密集的预测中反复出现。

blocks.en: Difficulty and learning value are not the same quantity. Curriculum learning [ 15 ] typically orders samples from easy to hard, but in CECS, apparent easiness can arise from residual texture contrast that reveals the object. Prioritizing samples with low loss or error may therefore encourage reliance on fragile high-frequency cues instead of shape and context. This concern is supported by our experiments: under a matched budget, naive easy-to-hard ordering performs no better than random ordering, while conventional schedules can reduce accuracy. Frequency-intervention results further show greater sensitivity to high-frequency perturbations after naive easy-first training.
blocks.zh: 难度和学习价值并不相同。 课程学习[15] 通常从容易到硬的订购样本,但在CECS中,从揭示对象的残余纹理对比中可以产生明显的易感性. 因此,将丢失或误差较低的样本列为优先事项,可能鼓励依赖脆弱的高频提示而不是形状和上下文。 我们的实验证实了这一关切:在相应的预算下,天真容易硬化的订单执行的并不比随机订购好,而常规时间表可以降低准确性。 频率干预结果进一步表明,在天真易行的第一训练之后,对高频扰动的敏感性更高。

blocks.en: Hard samples pose a complementary challenge: high prediction error can reflect either informative visual difficulty or unreliable supervision. A well-concealed object may be difficult yet informative, whereas weak annotations, imperfect ground-truth quality [ 16 ] , label drift, or intrinsically ambiguous regions can produce high errors without equally useful training signals. Since a static difficulty score cannot reliably distinguish these cases, difficulty-based selection may discard informative samples while retaining unreliable ones, increasing the risk of overfitting.
blocks.zh: 硬样本构成一个互补的挑战:高预测误差既可以反映信息化的视觉困难,也可以反映不可靠的监督. 一个隐蔽的物体可能很困难,但信息却很丰富,而说明不力、地面真实质量不完美[16]、标签漂移或内在模糊不清的区域则可能在没有同样有用的培训信号的情况下产生严重错误。 由于静态难度分数无法可靠地区分这些案例,基于难度的选择可能会丢弃信息性样本,同时保留不可靠的样本,从而增加过于适应的风险.

blocks.en: Confidence, finally, is not reliability. Uncertain boundary and low-contrast regions can dominate early gradients, while high confidence need not imply correctness. Directly rewarding confidence can therefore reinforce errors and degrade calibration.
blocks.zh: 最后,信心不是可靠性。 不确定的边界和低混凝土区域可主导早期梯度,而高度信心则不一定意味着正确。 因此,直接奖励信心可以强化错误,降低校准。

blocks.en: Together, these three observations suggest that reliable training must distinguish supervision quality from temporal learning value, regulate uncertain pixels, and challenge shortcut reliance only after initial stabilization is reached.
blocks.zh: 这三项意见合在一起表明,可靠的培训必须区分监督质量与时间学习价值,调节不确定的像素,并且只有在达到初步稳定后才能挑战对捷径的依赖.

blocks.en: From CurriSeg to PaceShift. Our conference work CurriSeg [ 17 ] , published at ICML 2026, introduced a two-phase stabilize-then-challenge framework for CECS. It combined dense-mask difficulty trajectories, temporal sample weighting, pixel uncertainty weighting, and single-radius spectral-blindness fine-tuning (SBFT). However, its difficulty score required dense ground-truth masks and could not be applied uniformly across weak, semi-supervised, and model-derived supervision. Moreover, its single-radius spectral stage lacked a mechanism for assessing the reliability of alternative predictions. To address these limitations, we develop PaceShift (Fig. 2 ), which retains the two-phase design while introducing supervision-adaptive curriculum selection and guarded multi-radius post-training with reference-relative preference learning. These changes extend the training framework without modifying the deployed architecture or increasing inference cost.
blocks.zh: 从CurriSeg到PaceShift。 我们的会议工作CurriSeg [17],在ICML 2026上发表,为CECS引入了两阶段稳定-时挑战框架. 它结合了稠密-遮盖难度轨迹,时间样本权重,像素不确定性权重,以及单辐射光谱盲微调(SBFT). 然而,其难度得分需要密集的地面真人面具,无法统一适用于薄弱、半监督的和模型产生的监督。 此外,其单射线光谱级缺乏评估替代预测可靠性的机制。 为了克服这些限制,我们开发了PaceShift(图2),它保留了两阶段的设计,同时采用了监督-适应性课程选择和看守的多射线后培训,同时进行参考-相对偏好学习。 这些变化扩大了培训框架,但没有改变已部署的结构或增加推论费用。

blocks.en: Scope. CECS serves as our primary setting for studying supervision reliability and texture shortcuts together. Experiments on broader dense-prediction tasks evaluate the transfer of the full training framework, while mechanism-specific evidence is established primarily in CECS and unreliable-supervision settings.
blocks.zh: 范围。 CECS是我们研究监管可靠性和纹理快捷键的主要环境。 对更广泛的密集预测任务的实验评价了整个培训框架的转移,而机制方面的具体证据主要在CECS和不可靠的监督环境中建立。

blocks.en: This paper makes four contributions:
blocks.zh: 本文件提出了四点意见:

blocks.en: (1) A learning-dynamics view of dense prediction (Sec. III-B ). We explain why naive easy-first curricula can amplify fragile shortcuts and why the stabilize-then-challenge framework succeeds, separating supervision reliability from temporal update value and treating SBFT as a post-stabilization frequency bottleneck whose order matters.
blocks.zh: (1) 密集预测的学习动力学视角(第III-B节)。 我们解释为什么天真的简易课程可以扩大脆弱的捷径,为什么稳定-当时的挑战框架能够成功,将监管可靠性与时间更新值区分开来,并将SBFT视为稳定后频率的瓶颈,其顺序很重要。

blocks.en: (2) Supervision-adaptive curriculum selection (Sec. III-C ). We replace ground-truth difficulty with a reliability score combining available supervision, augmentation consistency, model disagreement, and prediction uncertainty, yielding one curriculum under full, weak, semi-supervised, and model-derived supervision while reducing confirmation bias.
blocks.zh: (2) 监督调整课程选择(第III-C节)。 我们用可靠性分数取代地面真实困难,将现有的监督、增强一致性、模型分歧和预测不确定性结合起来,在全面、薄弱、半监督以及模型产生的监督之下产生一个课程,同时减少确认偏差。

blocks.en: (3) Guarded anti-curriculum post-training (Sec. III-D ). SBFT-P (SBFT with preference-guarded post-training) combines multi-radius spectral challenges with a supervision-adaptive preference guard based on correctness, robustness, and consistency, with uncertainty as a weak penalty and not as the sole selection rule, improving robustness while reducing overconfidence in the evaluated settings and recovering the original SBFT as a special case under full supervision.
blocks.zh: (3)守备的抗曲棍球后训练(第III-D节). SBFT-P(SBFT带有偏好保护的后训练)将多射线光谱挑战与基于正确性,稳健性,一致性的监督适应性偏好警卫相结合,不确定性作为弱罚而非唯一选择规则,提高稳健性的同时降低评价环境下的过度自信,并将原SBFT恢复为全面监督下的特殊情况.

blocks.en: (4) Systematic validation and diagnostics (Sec. IV ). We evaluate PaceShift across multiple dense-prediction families, supervision regimes, architectures, data-centric baselines, and foundation-model and cross-modal settings. Targeted experiments examine training dynamics, supervision reliability, candidate selection, corruption robustness, and calibration without additional inference computation.
blocks.zh: (4)系统鉴定和诊断(第四节). 我们评价PaceShift 跨越多个密集预测的家族、监督制度、架构、以数据为中心的基线以及基础模型和跨模式设置。 有针对性的试验审查培训动态、监督的可靠性、候选人的甄选、腐败的稳健性和校准性,而不进行额外的推论计算。

blocks.en: Beyond the methodological changes, this journal extension substantially expands the evaluation of CurriSeg [ 17 ] . We extend the broader dense-prediction evaluation to clinical, dichotomous, and salient segmentation; add vision-language and reference-guided evaluations; expand data-centric comparisons; and report paired-run statistical tests. Targeted analyses of supervision reliability, temporal update value, guard selection, phase ordering, frequency sensitivity, corruption robustness, and calibration further examine the underlying mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 除了方法变化外,该期刊扩展大大扩展了CurriSeg的评价[17]. 我们把更广泛的密集预测评价扩大到临床、二分体和突出的分化;增加视觉语言和参考指导评价;扩大以数据为中心的比较;以及报告对等的统计测试。 有针对性地分析监督的可靠性、时间更新价值、警卫选择、相位顺序、频率敏感性、腐败强度和校准程度,进一步审查基本机制。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Context-entangled and dense prediction segmentation. CECS spans camouflaged object detection [ 3 , 18 ] , transparent object detection [ 19 ] , and concealed defect detection [ 13 ] , with polyp segmentation [ 20 ] as a closely related low-contrast task. Progress has been mostly architectural: encoder-decoder backbones with multi-scale aggregation [ 7 ] , attention-based refinement [ 9 ] , edge- or uncertainty-aware branches [ 10 , 21 ] , transformer context modeling [ 22 ] , and frequency-aware modules [ 11 ] .
These works strengthen representation but keep a standard supervised routine with shuffled mini-batches, so the roles of sample difficulty, label ambiguity, and texture shortcuts in the learning dynamics remain underexplored. Reversible unfolding [ 12 ] and nested unfolding [ 14 ] designs have begun to inject inductive structure into the decoder, yet the optimization schedule itself is rarely treated as an explicit design variable.
blocks.zh:
上下文缠绕和密集的预测分化. CECS跨越伪装对象探测[3,18],透明对象探测[19],隐藏缺陷探测[13],多肽分解[20]作为密切相关的低毗连任务. 进展多为建筑设计:多尺度集成的编码器-解码器骨干[7],基于注意力的精细化[9],边缘或不确定性感知分支[10,21],变压器上下文模型[22],频率感知模块[11].
这些作品强化了代表性,但保持了标准监督的例行程序,用洗涤的迷你枪管,因此在学习动力学中,样本难度,标签模糊度,纹理快捷键的作用仍然没有得到充分发挥. 逆向运行 [12] 和嵌入运行 [14] 设计开始向解码器注入导电结构,然而优化表本身却很少被视为一个明确的设计变量.

blocks.en:
Curriculum learning and self-paced learning. Curriculum learning orders training from easy to hard to improve generalization [ 15 , 23 ] , with variants in self-paced learning [ 24 ] , teacher-student curricula [ 25 , 26 ] , and loss- or hardness-based ranking [ 27 , 28 ] . These methods assume that easy samples give reliable supervision and that difficulty tracks learning utility. Both break in CECS: easy samples may carry spurious texture that promotes shortcuts, and hard samples can be at once informative and ambiguous, consistent with analyses showing that the benefit of ordering depends sharply on data structure [ 26 ] .
Most curricula also ignore the pixel-level uncertainty of dense prediction, and almost none deliberately increase difficulty after a stable solution is reached.
PaceShift instead separates reliability from temporal update value, extends the curriculum to pixels, and introduces a post-stabilization anti-curriculum.
blocks.zh:
课程学习和自我节奏学习。 课程学习命令培训从容易到难以改进通俗化[15,23],自学节奏的变体[24],师生课程[25,26],基于损失或硬度的排名[27,28]. 这些方法假定,简单的样本可以提供可靠的监督,而且难以跟踪学习的效用。 CECS的两种断层:容易的样本可能带有促进快捷键的虚假纹理,硬样本可同时提供信息和含糊不清,这与分析表明订购的好处严重取决于数据结构[26]相一致.
大多数课程也忽略了密集预测的像素级不确定性,在达成稳定解决方案后,几乎没有任何课程会故意增加难度.
PaceShift转而将可靠性与时间更新值区分开来,将课程扩展至像素,并引入了稳定后反曲线.

blocks.en: Data-centric learning: training dynamics and data efficiency. Training-dynamics methods characterize examples through evolving predictions, losses, margins, or gradients, including forgetting events [ 29 , 30 ] , EL2N and GraNd [ 31 ] , dataset cartography [ 32 ] , and AUM [ 33 ] . Dyn-Unc [ 34 ] and TDDS [ 35 ] further exploit temporal variability, while InfoBatch [ 36 ] and SeTa [ 37 ] dynamically remove low-value samples for efficiency. ADELE [ 38 ] instead uses early-learning dynamics to correct noisy labels. Most of these formulations assume sample-level labels and do not directly address sparse, pixel-level, or model-derived supervision. PaceShift builds on this line of work but derives the trajectory from supervision-adaptive dense reliability, couples it with pixel-level uncertainty, and follows stabilization with guarded post-training. Its aim is accuracy, robustness, and calibration under spatially and supervision-dependent unreliability, not pruning or label correction.
blocks.zh: 以数据为中心的学习:培训动态和数据效率。 培训-动力学方法通过不断变化的预测、损失、差值或梯度,包括遗忘事件[29、30]、EL2N和GRANd[31]、数据集制图[32]和AUM[33]来描述实例。 Dyn-Unc [34]和TDDS [35] 进一步利用时间变异性,而InfoBatch [36] 和 SeTa [37] 动态删除低值样本以提高效率. ADEELE [38] 取而代之的是使用早期学习动态来纠正吵闹的标签. 这些制剂大多假定样品级标签,不直接处理稀疏,像素级,或模型衍生的监管. PaceShift以这一条工作线为基础,但从监督-适应性密集的可靠性中得出轨迹,与像素水平的不确定性相配,并借助有戒备的后训练实现稳定。 其目的是在空间和监督依赖的不可靠性下准确性、稳健性和校准,而不是纠错或标签。

blocks.en:
Learning under incomplete supervision. Weakly and semi-supervised segmentation learn from sparse annotations or unlabeled data through consistency regularization and pseudo-labeling [ 39 , 40 ] .
A recurring failure is confirmation bias: training on the model’s own confident predictions reinforces existing errors [ 41 ] . In CECS this is acute, since confidence and correctness diverge in concealed regions, so a confidence threshold both keeps wrong pseudo-labels and discards hard but correct ones.
PaceShift instead combines confidence, disagreement, consistency, and an external foundation-model cue for reliability estimation, whereas SEE [ 42 ] generates changing pseudo-labels from a frozen SAM and SCALER [ 43 ] jointly adapts SAM and the segmenter.
blocks.zh:
在不完整的监督下学习。 通过一致性规范化和伪标签化[39,40],弱度和半监督分解从零散的说明或无标签数据中学习.
反复发生的失败就是确认偏差:关于模型自身自信预测的培训强化了现有的错误[41]. 在CECS中,这种情况很严重,因为信任和正确性在隐蔽区域有所不同,因此,信任门槛既会保留错误的伪标签,也会丢弃硬但正确的标签。
相反,PaceShift结合了信心、分歧、一致性和外部基础模型提示来进行可靠性估计,而SE [42] 则从冷冻的SAM和SCALER [43] 中生成变化的伪标签,共同调整SAM和分线器。

blocks.en: Shortcut bias, texture bias, and frequency-domain learning. Networks trained by SGD favor the simplest features that separate the data even when more robust ones exist, studied as simplicity bias [ 44 , 45 ] and, for vision, texture bias [ 46 ] . This differs from the spectral bias of network functions, which learn the low-frequency components of the input-output map first [ 47 ] . The two concern different frequencies, image versus function, and conflating them yields contradictory predictions about a low-pass operation. We therefore frame SBFT as suppressing a high-frequency image shortcut to counteract texture bias without invoking function-space spectral bias.

We adopt a related pairwise objective for dense predictions and define preferences through correctness, robustness, and consistency on dense masks.

blocks.en: III-B 1 Easy samples amplify a high-frequency shortcut
blocks.zh: III-B 1 简单样本放大高频快捷键

blocks.en: In a context-entangled scene, an object is concealed when its appearance matches the background. In CECS, one recurring source of apparent easiness is residual local high-frequency texture contrast that separates the object from its background. A model trained on these first can minimize the loss by keying on that texture difference, a feature that is cheap to fit and locally discriminative but does not transfer to well-concealed cases. This is an instance of simplicity and texture bias [ 44 ] : gradient descent prefers the simplest separating feature even when a more robust shape or context feature exists. This is not the classical spectral bias of network functions [ 47 , 56 ] , which concerns the order in which frequencies of the input-output map are learned. Here the relevant frequency is in image space, and the pathology is that early easy-first training increases reliance on a high-frequency image cue. This motivates the two phases: keep shortcut-prone easy samples from dominating early training, then suppress the high-frequency channel once a sufficiently stable representation exists.
blocks.zh: 在上下文缠绕的场景中,当物体的外观与背景相匹配时会隐藏它. 在CECS中,一个反复出现的表面易感源是残余的局部高频纹理对比,将物体与其背景区分开来. 首先接受过这些培训的模型可以通过按下纹理差异的键将损失减少到最低程度,这一特征适合当地并具有歧视性,但不会转移到隐蔽的病例中。 这是一个简单和纹理偏差的例子[44]:梯度下降更倾向于最简单的分离特征,即使存在更坚固的形状或上下文特征. 这不是网络功能的经典光谱偏差[47,56],它涉及输入输出图的频率学习的顺序. 这里的相关频率处于图像空间,病理是早期的简易第一训练会增加对高频图像提示的依赖. 这激发了两个阶段的动力:保持捷径易用的样本在早期训练中占据主导地位,然后在存在足够稳定的表示后压制高频通道.

blocks.en:
A single difficulty value cannot tell an informative hard sample from a noisy one, while the training trajectory can. For sample i i let d i ( k ) d_{i}^{(k)} denote its difficulty at checkpoint k k . Two patterns are used as heuristics. A high variance of { d i ( k ) } k \{d_{i}^{(k)}\}_{k} reflects strong temporal variation, which is common near decision boundaries or under intrinsic ambiguity. A high mean with low variance reflects persistent failure, which can arise from outliers or label errors that the model cannot resolve, and the empirical rule down-weights it.
This reading aligns with example-difficulty and forgetting analyses [ 29 , 31 ] and with Dyn-Unc and TDDS [ 34 , 35 ] , which likewise exploit training dynamics instead of a single value. We import neither score directly: we model the mean, the variance, and the persistent-failure pattern of high mean and low variance as separate, individually ablatable terms on the supervision-adaptive difficulty of Sec. III-C , because the noise-ambiguity dilemma of CECS requires distinguishing all three under any supervision regime.
This is what motivates the parameter-free mid-variance preference and the outlier penalty ω out \omega^{\mathrm{out}} in Sec. III-C : intermediate temporal variation serves as a heuristic for potentially informative hardness, whereas persistent stability and persistent failure are down-weighted.

blocks.en:
Conditioning on a language prompt or a reference image adds one axis of unreliability: the mask may disagree with the conditioning even when the model is internally confident. We instantiate the existing cues rather
than introducing new ones, leaving ρ i \rho_{i} and Q ⁡ ( m ) Q(m) unchanged and s i sup s_{i}^{\mathrm{sup}} mask-level. Language conditioning uses prompt-paraphrase consistency, the agreement across semantically equivalent rephrasings, and vision-text disagreement, the gap to a vision-only prediction. Reference conditioning analogously uses reference-swap consistency and vision-reference disagreement. Conditioned predictions provide reliability evidence, not fixed training labels, while the trust level continues to follow the primary supervision source (Table I ).

blocks.en: III-D Guarded Anti-Curriculum Promotion
blocks.zh: III-D 守备反urriculum 晋升

blocks.en: Once SA-RCS stabilizes at epoch T c T_{c} , we raise difficulty on purpose. The conference SBFT applied a single low-pass filter and fine-tuned against the mask. We extend it into a guarded post-training stage, SBFT-P, that creates a spectral challenge of several strengths, scores the resulting candidate predictions with a supervision-adaptive guard, and refines the model with a guarded preference objective. The guard is what keeps the stage from reducing to confidence maximization.
blocks.zh: 一旦SA-RCS稳定在 epoch T c T_{c}, 我们故意提高难度。 会议SBFT采用了单一的低通滤波器,并对口罩进行了微调. 我们把它推广到一个有戒备的训练后阶段,即SBFT-P,这个阶段产生了具有数种强项的光谱挑战,将由此得出的候选人预测结果评分为监督适应性卫士,并以有戒备的偏好目标来完善模型. 守护者是阻止舞台下降至信心最大化的原因.

blocks.en: Overhead. Modest training overhead comes only from the periodic augmented and stochastic forward predictions that refresh the Phase-I reliability cues, and from the spectral-candidate and frozen-reference evaluations of Phase II. The temporal history stores one scalar per refresh checkpoint per sample in memory, and the reduced active subset in Phase I offsets part of the extra computation (Table III ).

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en:
Tasks, datasets, and metrics. We group three core CECS tasks and the related polyp-segmentation task into the CECS suite: camouflaged object detection (COD) on CAMO [ 64 ] , COD10K [ 1 ] , CHAMELEON [ 65 ] , and NC4K [ 66 ] ,
polyp image segmentation (PIS) trained on Kvasir [ 67 ] and ClinicDB [ 68 ] and evaluated on CVC-ColonDB [ 69 ] and ETIS [ 70 ] , transparent object detection (TOD) on GDD [ 19 ] and GSD [ 71 ] , and zero-shot concealed defect detection (CDD) on CDS2K [ 13 ] .
We further test broader generality across infrared small-target detection ( IRSTD-1k [ 72 ] ), shadow detection ( SBU [ 73 ] ), medical lesion and fluid segmentation ( ISIC 2018 [ 74 ] and RETOUCH [ 75 ] ), dichotomous and salient segmentation ( DIS-VD [ 76 ] and DUTS-TE [ 77 ] ), and semantic ( ADE20K [ 78 ] ) and instance ( COCO [ 79 ] ) segmentation, and supervision generality under point and semi-supervised settings, foundation-model adaptation, and language- and reference-conditioned segmentation. For COD, we report mean absolute error ( M M ), adaptive F-measure ( F β F_{\beta} ) [ 80 ] , mean E-measure ( E ϕ E_{\phi} ) [ 81 ] , and structure measure ( S α S_{\alpha} ) [ 82 ] . PIS uses mean Dice, mIoU, and S α S_{\alpha} , TOD uses mIoU, F β max F_{\beta}^{\max} , and M M , and CDD adds the mean F-measure ( F β m F_{\beta}^{m} ) to the COD metrics. Other tasks use their standard metrics.
We assess calibration using pixel-pooled ECE [ 83 ] . We also report a ground-truth-stratified confidence–accuracy gap ( GT ​ - ​ CAG \mathrm{GT\text{-}CAG} , the mean of the gaps computed on ground-truth foreground and background pixels), a boundary-restricted gap ( CAG bnd \mathrm{CAG}_{\mathrm{bnd}} ), and WConf, the mean confidence on incorrectly predicted pixels. These three are complementary diagnostics of where confidence departs from accuracy, not measures of global calibration, since a calibrated predictor can have a nonzero stratified gap.
Please see details in the Supp.

任务、数据集和衡量标准。 我们把三个核心CECS任务和相关的多块组合任务组合到CECS套件中:CAMO[64]上的伪装物体探测(COD),COD10K[1],CHAMELEON[65],NC4K[66],
在Kvasir [67]和ClinicDB [68] 上接受多肽图像分解(PIS)培训,并在CVC-CoronDB [69]和ETIS [70]上接受评价,在GDD [19]和GSD [71]上接受透明物体检测(TOD),在CDS2K上接受零镜头隐蔽缺陷检测(CDD) [13].
我们进一步测试红外小目标探测(IRSTD-1k [72]),阴影探测(SCU [73]),医疗损伤和流体分解(2018年国际标准行业分类[74]和RETOUCH[75]),二重分解和突出分解(DIS-VD[76]和DUTS-TE[77]),以及语义(ADE20K[78])和实例(COCO[79])分解,以及根据点和半监督环境、基础模型适应、语言和参照条件分解进行监督的一般性。 就COD而言,我们报告的是绝对错误(M M),适应性的F-度量衡(F β F_{\βββββ)[80],E-度量衡(E φE_{\phi)[81],以及结构度量衡(S α S_{\alpha})[82]。 PIS使用平均值Dice,mIoU,和S α S_{\alpha},TOD使用平均值MOU,F β 最大 F_{\beta}^{\max}和M M,CDD在COD的度量标准中增加了平均值F度量(F β m F_{\beta}^{m}). 其他任务使用其标准衡量标准.
我们利用像素集成的欧洲经委会评估校准[83]。 我们也报告一个地面- 真实的置信- 准确性差距( GT - CAG\ mathrm{ GT\ text{ -} CAG}), 即根据地面- 真实前景和背景像素计算出的空隙的平均值, 边界限制的空隙( CAG bnd\ mathrm{ CAG\ mathrm{ bnd}), 和WConf, 对错误预测的像素的平均值。 这三项是补充性诊断,说明信心偏离准确性的地方,而不是全球校准的尺度,因为校准的预测器可能存在非零级差距。

blocks.en: IV-C Generalization across Architectures
blocks.zh: 四-C 跨建筑的概括

blocks.en:
PaceShift replaces a training schedule, not a module, so it should compose with any segmenter. Table VIII attaches the identical recipe, with identical global constants, to thirteen configurations of twelve detectors spanning encoder-decoder, graph, bio-inspired, frequency, attention, uncertainty, diffusion, unfolding, and foundation-model designs.
Each baseline keeps its own backbone, optimizer, and augmentation, and only the training recipe changes. Six rows reuse runs reported elsewhere: FEDER, FSEL, RUN, and the two NUN rows are the COD10K results of the canonical runs in Table II , and the SAM-Adapter row repeats Table XIV . The remaining seven detectors are trained under their native epoch budgets with the phase boundaries scaled as in the Supp. Three observations follow.
(1) Every configuration improves, within a band of 3.8 3.8 to 6.5 6.5 percent, and PaceShift exceeds CurriSeg on all thirteen rows.
(2) It is complementary to architectural modeling of the very quantities it controls: UGTR already reasons about uncertainty inside the network and is nonetheless among the larger beneficiaries, and FSEL, which models frequency, still gains, because such a module changes how features are computed while the schedule changes what training signal the optimizer receives .
(3) The gains persist under the adaptation regime that is replacing task-specific training: DINO V2 and the frozen SAM adapter improve by 4.3 4.3 and 4.7 4.7 percent without any change to their adapters or frozen weights.
blocks.zh:
PaceShift取代了训练时间表,而不是模块,因此它应该与任何分段器组成. 表八将相同的配方和相同的全球常数附在跨越编码器-解码器、图、生物启发、频率、注意力、不确定性、扩散、正在发展以及基础模型设计的13个配置的12个探测器上。
每个基准都保持自己的骨干、优化和增强,只有培训方法发生变化。 其他报道的6行重复运行:FEDER,FSEL,RUN,以及两个NUN行是表II中的犬科运行的COD10K结果,SAM-Adapter行重复表十四. 其余的7个探测器是在其时代预算下经过培训的,其相位界限与《补充计划》中的相位界限相同。 以下三项意见。
(1) 在3.8-6.5%的波段内,每个配置都有改进,所有13行的PaceShift超过CurriSeg。
(2) 它是对其控制的数量的建筑模型的补充: UGTR已经为网络内部的不确定性提供了理由,但仍然是较大的受益者之一,而模拟频率的FSEL仍在增加,因为这样的模块会改变特性的计算方式,而时间表则改变培训信号优化者得到的特性。
(3) 在取代特定任务培训的适应制度下,收益依然存在:DINO V2和冷冻SAM适配器提高了4.3.3%和4.7%,其适配器或冷冻重量没有任何变化。

blocks.en: IV-D Generalization to Broader Dense Prediction Families
blocks.zh: IV-D 向更广泛的预测家庭推广

blocks.en:
To assess PaceShift beyond CECS, we evaluate increasingly diverse dense-prediction tasks exhibiting high-frequency shortcuts, supervision-reliability variation, both, or neither prominently (Sec. III-B ).
Tier 1 collects low-contrast detection with ambiguous annotation, Tier 2 low-contrast clinical dense prediction, and Tier 3 salient object detection and dichotomous segmentation with standard semantic and instance segmentation, the last using the multi-class instantiation of Sec. III-C . For each family, Table IX keeps one strong published baseline’s architecture, optimizer, augmentation, and epoch budget, changes only the training strategy with no constant retuned, and reports the family’s primary metric.
blocks.zh:
为了评估CECS以外的PaceShift,我们评价了日益多样化的密集预测任务,这些任务都显示出高频捷径、监督-可靠性的变异,或者两者都不突出(第III-B节)。
第1级收集低孔断层探测器,带有模糊的注释, 第二级低沉积临床密集预测,第三级显性物体检测和二焦离子分化与标准语义和实例分化,最后一次使用Sec. III-C的多级即时分化. 对于每个家庭来说,表九都保留着一个已公布的强有力的基线结构、优化、扩充和划时代预算,只改变培训战略,没有不断调整,并报告家庭的主要衡量标准。

blocks.en: Tier 1: low-contrast detection with ambiguous annotation. Infrared small-target detection (IRSTD) and shadow detection are low-contrast but not texture-matched, and both carry substantial annotation ambiguity [ 73 ] . Gains persist here although the texture shortcut is weaker, indicating that the full formulation is not limited to shortcut-dominated data.
blocks.zh: 第1级:低混凝土探测,带有模糊的注释。 红外小目标探测(IRSTD)和阴影探测都是低孔隙但纹理不匹配,两者都带有实质性的注释模糊性[73]. 虽然纹理的快捷方式较弱,但收益仍然在这里存在,这表明完全的配方并不限于快捷方式占主导地位的数据.

blocks.en: Tier 2: clinical dense prediction. Skin lesion and retinal OCT fluid segmentation combine low boundary contrast with costly, uncertain annotation, making supervision quality and boundary ambiguity particularly relevant to the reliability formulation. On RETOUCH, CurriSeg falls marginally below the baseline, whereas PaceShift recovers this loss and further improves performance under the same clinical setting.
blocks.zh: 第二级:临床密集预测。 皮肤损伤和视网膜OCT液分解将低边界对比与代价高昂、不确定的注解结合起来,使监督质量和边界模糊度与可靠性配方特别相关。 在RETOUCH上,CurriSeg略低于基线,而PaceShift则收回这一损失,并在同样的临床环境下进一步改善性能。

blocks.en: Tier 3: standard dense prediction. Dichotomous, salient, semantic, and instance segmentation are not defined by a texture-matched background. PaceShift nevertheless yields consistent gains under the native host budgets, with the same proportional stabilize-then-challenge schedule and without introducing task-specific constants. The multi-class and instance rows use the corresponding output-form instantiations of Sec. III-C . These results support transfer of the full training paradigm beyond context-entangled settings.
blocks.zh: 第三级:标准密度预测。 Dichotomous,显性,语义,和实例的分化没有被纹理匹配的背景所定义. 尽管如此,PaceShift在本地东道国预算下不断获得收益,在不采用特定任务常数的情况下,有同样的比例稳定-当时的挑战时间表。 多类和实例行使用Sec.III-C的相应输出-形式即兴. 这些成果有助于将全面培训模式从内在环境转移出去。

blocks.en: Online strategies. Three observations follow from Table X . A naive loss curriculum hurts under this schedule, consistent with Sec. III-B and with its null effect under the matched budget of Table XIX : easy, clean samples first let the model commit to the texture shortcut. Second, the trajectory scores Dyn-Unc and TDDS are the strongest prior baselines, which supports our premise that the relevant signal is a trajectory property. Third, SA-RCS alone exceeds both on F β F_{\beta} , E ϕ E_{\phi} , and S α S_{\alpha} while remaining comparable in M M , and the full PaceShift widens the margin: the distinction is the supervision-adaptive reliability score, its online refresh, the pixel-level coupling, and the guarded post-training, none of which these efficiency-oriented scores designed for classification provide.

blocks.en: Fixed-retention coreset study. Fig. 5 evaluates a representative one-shot score per family as the F β F_{\beta} gain over random selection. blocks.en: Modern dense prediction often adapts frozen foundation backbones using lightweight adapters. We evaluate SAM-, SAM2-, and SAM3-Adapters [ 49 , 107 , 108 ] on COD under the canonical full-supervision protocol, comparing each baseline with CurriSeg and PaceShift. The prompt-ensembled frozen foundation model serves as teacher and the adapter-tuned model as student. Their disagreement provides reliability evidence, while the teacher mask is never treated as GT. The proposal informs the disagreement cue in ρ i \rho_{i} and the consistency term Q cons Q_{\mathrm{cons}} of Eq. 11 , while Q sup Q_{\mathrm{sup}} uses available mask supervision. Both phases share the same supervision-evidence construction without relying on teacher pseudo-labels. Table XIV shows that PaceShift improves every adapter and consistently exceeds CurriSeg.

blocks.en: A growing family of segmenters uses vision-language or reference information. We apply PaceShift to three such settings for controlled comparison, each with the original baseline and a stronger recent method, preserving the architecture, input protocol, optimizer, training horizon, and trainable parameter count while changing only data scheduling and post-training. Each setting is evaluated on its native benchmark with the corresponding official metrics. The unreliability PaceShift addresses is instantiated per case. The conference recipe is compared in the CECS and incomplete-supervision experiments, and this section reports PaceShift against the host baselines.

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: V-A Why the Paradigm Works
blocks.zh: 五A类 为什么范式工程

blocks.en: The diagnostics of Sec. IV-K say more when considered together than separately. Reliability and update value are two different quantities: ρ i \rho_{i} ranks held-out target quality more effectively than the evaluated confidence-based criteria (Tables XXV (a) and XIII ), whereas ω i \omega_{i} is the score most positively associated with the optimizer-conditioned alignment proxy, and instantaneous loss is negatively associated with it (Table XXV (b)). The guard selects low-regret candidates that confidence alone would not (Table XXVI ), both phases reduce high-frequency sensitivity (Table XXVII ), and the proposed order outperforms reversed and challenge-first schedules (Table XXII ). Together, these diagnostics support treating training order, supervision reliability, and post-training calibration as connected aspects of the training design.

blocks.en: V-B Scope and Limitations
blocks.zh: 五-B 范围和限制

blocks.en: Spectral intervention is most useful when targets and backgrounds share low-level statistics, as in camouflaged, polyp, and transparent segmentation, and this mechanism is most directly supported by the CECS diagnostics. The broader experiments evaluate the full training recipe without isolating the contribution of each phase (Table IX ). When an object occupies only a few pixels, spectral attenuation may remove useful target evidence along with nuisance cues, and residual failures also include overlapping instances and heavy occlusion (see the Supp.). Reliability-aware scheduling may offer smaller gains when sample reliability varies little, and incomplete-supervision settings that use external teacher or proposal evidence depend on its quality. Finally, Phase II adds modest training-time computation (Table III ) but no inference-time parameters or cost.
blocks.zh: 当目标和背景分享低层次的统计数据时,光谱干预最有用,例如伪装、多聚和透明分化,这种机制最直接得到CECS诊断的支持。 更广泛的试验在不孤立每个阶段的贡献的情况下评价全部培训方法(表九)。 当一个物体只占据了几个像素时,光谱衰减可能会同时去除有用的目标证据和扰动提示,剩余的故障还包括重叠事件和重掩蔽(见Supp. 当样本可靠性变化不大时,了解可靠性的时间安排可能带来较小的收益,而使用外部教师或建议书证据的不完整监督设置则取决于其质量。 终于 第二阶段增加了适度的培训时间计算(表三),但没有推断时间参数或费用。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en:
PaceShift turns CurriSeg’s setting-specific training recipe into a unified supervision-adaptive formulation and replaces its unguarded single-radius post-training with guarded multi-radius preference learning.
Across CECS tasks, incomplete supervision, foundation-model adaptation, and broader dense prediction, it improves accuracy, and targeted evaluations show improved pooled calibration and corruption robustness in the evaluated settings and support the proposed mechanism.
blocks.zh:
跳转 CurriSeg将特定培训配方编成一种统一的监督适应性配方,并用防守的多辐射偏好学习来取代其无人看守的单射线后培训。
在整个CECS任务、监督不全、基础模型调整和更广泛的密集预测过程中,它提高了准确性,有针对性的评价显示,在评价环境中,集合校准和腐败程度有所提高,并支持拟议机制。
